items.label: Latest Android 15 Kids Tablet with 8-Core Processor & Gemini AI
items.value: Equipped with an enhanced Android 15 system and powered by a rapid 2.0GHz 8-core processor, 4GB RAM, and 64GB storage (expandable to 1TB), this 10-inch kids tablet delivers smooth performance for learning and entertainment. Enhanced by Gemini AI, it acts as a smart learning companion—assisting with homework, explaining concepts interactively, and adapting to your child's pace. Android 15 ensures a secure, user-friendly interface with strong privacy protection, kid-friendly themes, and easy operations, all backed by Google GMS certification.

items.label: Google Kids Space + Parental Control
items.value: The PlimPad Kids tablet comes pre-installed with Google Kids Space and educator-endorsed apps, tailored for children aged 3 and above. Offering activities like animal coloring, simple crafts, story listening, and puzzle games, children can engage in enjoyable learning experiences. With user-friendly parental controls, you can filter content, establish educational targets, and set time restrictions, fostering a secure online environment for kids.

items.label: 10.1" HD IPS Glass Screen + Eye Protection Mode
items.value: This Android 15 kids tablet features a 10.1" HD IPS glass screen with a 1280 x 800 resolution, delivering clear, vivid images. Specifically designed for toddlers, it incorporates low blue light technology and eye protection mode, along with automatic brightness adjustment, effectively reducing eye fatigue and enhancing the enjoyment of learning and entertainment for children.

items.label: Rugged Anti-drop EVA Protective Case
items.value: The 10-inch kids tablet is equipped with an environmentally friendly EVA material protective case, purposefully designed for children. This case is odorless, resistant to deformation, and provides a comfortable grip. It offers superior durability and impact resistance compared to silicone cases while remaining lightweight. Additionally, the 360° rotatable bracket allows for optimal viewing angles, eliminating the need for children to hold the tablet while learning. Precise port incisions ensure accessibility to all functions.

items.label: Optimized Battery Performance
items.value: Engineered to support a child's typical daily use of learning apps, videos, and games for extended periods on a single charge. The upgraded power system provides approximately 30% longer runtime compared to our original model, all while leveraging Android 15's efficiency for smarter power management.

items.label: 🎁Perfect Gift + 2 Years Warrenty
items.value: Looking for the perfect gift for children on birthdays, Thanksgiving, Christmas, or any special occasion? The PlimPad Kids20 toddler tablet, featuring a blend of educational puzzle games and knowledge, is an excellent choice! Rest easy with our 2-year warranty and a 30-day worry-free return and replacement policy, as Plimpton is committed to providing top-notch professional kids' tablets and services. Have any questions? Don't hesitate to reach out, and our team will be dedicated to resolving any concerns.
